sentences.text: As the clock ticked past 04:20, the living room sensors began to register an unusual cold spot.
The temperature dipped down to 18.4 °C, falling below the predicted norm of 19.7 °C.
The ghostly chill peaked at 05:50, creating a mysterious drop from the expected range of 19.3 °C to 20.0 °C.
This strange, chilly presence remained in the living room until 06:00.
